(()=>{let variants=0,matches=0;const assert=(b,s)=>{if(!b)throw Error(s)};for(const c of LAB.data.examples){LAB.selectCase(c.id);for(const v of c.variants){document.getElementById('fn').value=v.fn;document.getElementById('flags').value=v.flags;document.getElementById('flags').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));assert(document.getElementById('result').textContent===v.result_repr,'result '+c.id);assert(document.getElementById('code').textContent===v.code,'code');assert(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.char')).map(e=>e.dataset.char).join('')===c.text,'full text');for(let i=0;i<v.matches.length;i++){document.getElementById('matches').children[i].click();let m=v.matches[i];assert(LAB.state.index===i,'index');assert([...document.querySelectorAll('.char.hit')].map(x=>x.dataset.char).join('')===m.text,'highlight');assert(document.querySelectorAll('.zero').length===(m.span[0]===m.span[1]?1:0),'zero');assert([...document.querySelectorAll('.char.hit')].every(x=>Number(x.dataset.index)>=m.span[0]&&Number(x.dataset.index)<m.span[1]),'codepoint');matches++;}variants++;}}LAB.selectCase(3);return {pass:true,cases:LAB.data.examples.length,variants,matches,overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth};})()
